title: Friday Morning Fog
description: Patchy areas of fog are possible across portions of northern and central Oklahoma near/after sunrise on Friday morning. Visibility as low as one-quarter mile will be possible, so make sure to use caution during the Friday morning commute!

title: Cool This Weekend; Warming Next Week
description: After two cooler days, temperatures will once again climb several degrees above normal. These warmer conditions look to continue for much of next week.
id: Cool This Weekend Warming Next Week

title: Next 7 Days
description: Cooler temperatures the next couple days with a warming trend expected into next week. Outside of very low rain chances on Veterans Day (Wednesday/11th), mostly dry weather is expected.
